action: Request a private, off-calendar meeting with Angela Wright — not in her office, not at HQ. Invite her to lunch at a location off auto row. The agenda is not 'I know you're talking to an attorney.' The agenda is: I want her to tell me, in her own words, what she is seeing in the organization and what she thinks we should be doing. Give her the conversational opening to be honest about her own position without forcing her to disclose. Make clear that her role in a restructuring scenario — if there is one — is not to be eliminated, it is to be the architect of it. Offer to discuss formalizing her participation in the strategic planning process with a defined retention agreement: 90-day stay bonus of $12,000, contingent on her leading the workforce transition plan, whatever form that takes.
